subject: DPIA evidence delivery cadence & inspector onboarding
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: DPIA evidence delivery cadence & inspector onboarding

Hi Daniel — following up from our call last week. Halcyon's legal team asked for a structured handoff of DPIA evidence ahead of the remote inspector next month. To keep this light, can we deliver artifacts in three small batches rather than one big drop?

Proposed cadence:
- Batch 1 (by Mon 2028-03-27): Article 28/30 ledger extract, current subprocessors CSV, and a short processing map (PDF).
- Batch 2 (by Wed 2028-03-29): KMS/key-management attestation, data retention policy excerpt, sample access logs (anonymized).
- Batch 3 (by Fri 2028-04-02): Environment diagram, onboarding/control assertions, and any requested audit-scoped traces.

Requested items for the inspector:
- Preferred delivery method (encrypted SFTP vs secure Drive)
- Any redaction rules we should apply to access log samples
- Inspector availability windows the week of April 8

Attached: proposed_manifest.csv (stub) — outlines files and example formats.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_manifest.csv (text/csv)

From: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@halcyon.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 13:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence delivery cadence & inspector onboarding

Thanks Naomi — that cadence looks sensible to us. Looping in Priya from legal to confirm redaction and NDA needs. A couple of quick clarifications: 

1) Our inspector prefers a ledger extract in CSV with these columns: subsystem, processing_purpose, legal_basis, data_categories, subprocessor_reference. Is Redwood able to include a data_categories column?
2) Encrypted SFTP is our preferred transfer mechanism. We will stand up an account for Redwood — can you share a public SSH key and preferred username format?

Also, our inspector will need a short statement of the sampling approach for access logs (i.e., sampling windows, redaction applied).

Appreciate it,
Daniel Reed
Senior Privacy Counsel
Halcyon Health
Attachments: none

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence delivery cadence & inspector onboarding

On Wed, 22 Mar 2028 at 13:05 Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@halcyonhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Naomi — that cadence looks sensible to us...

Thanks Daniel — yes we can include a data_categories column in the Article 30 CSV export. That will capture high-level categories (e.g., user_identifiers, billing, health_metrics).

Answers and delivery notes: 
- SSH public key: attaching 'redwood_sftp_pubkey.asc' (stub). Please confirm desired username pattern; we typically use redwood_<account> (e.g., redwood_halcyon).
- Redaction: for access logs we propose replacing IPs/hostnames with stable pseudonyms, and removing user identifiers. We'll provide a short redaction manifest with each batch.
- Sampling: we'll deliver 7-day windows (UTC) as a representative sample for Batch 2 unless you request a different window.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_processing_map_v1.pdf (processing map)
- subprocessor_register.csv (current list)
- access-log-sample-2028-03.csv (anonymized sample)
- redwood_sftp_pubkey.asc (ssh key stub)

Booking: here's a link to schedule inspector time 
https://calendly.com/redwood/privacy-inspector-30m
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/98765 (internal ref)

We'll wait for Priya to confirm any additional NDA/attestation language. Let us know if the SFTP approach is a blocker.

Best,
Naomi

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Mar 2028 11:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence delivery cadence & inspector onboarding (internal)

Internal note — couple of operational asks before we hand over Batch 2 logs:

- Confirm sampling rate: Naomi suggested a 7-day UTC window. For the inspector I'd recommend 3 non-consecutive windows (to avoid time-of-day bias): pick Mon–Sun chunk, Wed–Tue chunk, and a weekend-heavy chunk. We can mark which records are sampled.
- Redaction manifest: make sure the manifest states what fields were pseudonymized vs removed.
- Watermarking and provenance: please add a small watermark/header in PDF exports (e.g., "Redwood - DPIA sample - Halcyon - 2028-03-23") so we can track any leakage.

CCing Hannah and Marissa for sampling confirmation and to scope the environment diagram we plan to hand off in Batch 3.

Thanks,
Irene
Privacy Controls Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@halcyon.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 17:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence delivery cadence & inspector onboarding

Thanks Naomi — Priya has confirmed the limited-scope NDA will be sufficient, she will send a DocuSign link by tomorrow. Encrypted SFTP is fine; we will provision a user account and send host/port separately. Please use the username redwood_halcyon and share the public key file you attached.

Two small asks before Batch 1 drop:
- Can the Article 30 export include a data_retention_period column (ISO date or months) for each processing activity?
- Please confirm that access-log samples will have user identifiers removed and that the pseudonym mapping will not be reversible.

Once those are confirmed we will approve the SFTP credentials and the inspector booking. Thanks for coordinating the smaller batches — makes review much easier on our side.

Best,
Daniel
Senior Privacy Counsel
Halcyon Health
Attachments: none
